name: rosetta-increasing-gaps-between-consecutive-niven-numbers

use default

niven_numbers() -> Pipe[int] is
    let digit_sum mut = 1

    for value in 1::int.max_value do
        if value % digit_sum == 0 then
            yield value
        fi

        let trailing mut = value
        let change mut = 1

        while trailing % 10 == 9 do
            change = change - 9
            trailing = trailing / 10
        od

        digit_sum = digit_sum + change
    od
si

write_line("gap    index of gap    starting Niven")

let previous mut = 0
let previous_index mut = 0
let widest mut = 0
let index mut = 0

for niven in niven_numbers() |> take(10_000_001) do
    index = index + 1

    if previous_index > 0 /\ niven - previous > widest then
        widest = niven - previous

        write_line("{widest,3}{previous_index,16:N0}{previous,18:N0}")
    fi

    previous = niven
    previous_index = index
od
